observations: body L10: a short stroke stands above the sukūn of «الأَبْعَد», between L9 and L10; not transcribed. The hamza of «الأَبْعَد» carries its own fatha.
body L15: the parenthesis «(seu الحقيقيّ)» stands to the left of «البعد الابعد الحقّيّ», that is after it in the Arabic reading order; transcribed in the order of the line.
body L22: the o of «Boqṭor» is printed with its top broken off.

body L6, L27, L31, L34, L35, L37: «at–Tahānawī» (L31) and «Ibn ash–Shāṭir» (L37) are printed with a dash of 5.3-5.5 points, the length of the en dashes of «113,r.–v.», «116–120» and «161–» (L34), not with the hyphen of «’l-Walīd» (L6) and «al-‘arūs» (L27), 3.2-3.6 points; transcribed «–». «161–» (L34) and «165» (L35) are one range broken at the end of the line.
body L35: «هـو» is printed with a long join, transcribed with a tatweel.
body L38: a wedge-shaped mark is printed over the first u of «cuius»; not transcribed.
source_authority: Controlling master page image. Embedded text is not the authority for a reading.
transcription_convention: Source line breaks, hyphenation, quotation signs and word-level type distinctions retained. L numbers count text-bearing lines.
review_responsibility: Transcribed by Claude from the page images; Greek, Arabic, numbers and signs read on enlarged images. Not reviewed by a person.
